decisions.reason: The necessary batch-count effect is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY setting current_batch_product_count to 15.
The existing product_coverage rule already requires listing all selected products, so changing the current selected batch to 15 does not require a separate candidate-state change.
The batch count does not change the spreadsheet's recording timing or cross-channel structure.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY recording the 15-product batch target and five-minute deadline; no correction or additional update is needed.
The CJ Dropshipping batch-size decision does not alter Airbnb lead follow-up behavior.
The product-research batch count does not change the daily Airbnb host-outreach cadence.
Specifying 15 products for the current batch does not change the fallback rule for independently selecting other available work.
The current product-batch quantity does not affect where task artifacts or supporting links must be stored.
The CJ Dropshipping batch-size change is unrelated to the spreadsheet workflow for interested Airbnb leads.
